# Get-ZbxTask

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the tasks the server still tracks.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxTask [[-Id] <ulong[]>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxTask cmdlet reads tasks with task.get: the check-now, diagnostic and proxy reload requests made with Invoke-ZbxCheckNow, Invoke-ZbxDiagnostic, Sync-ZbxProxyConfig or New-ZbxTask, with their status and, for a diagnostic, its result. It writes every task the server still tracks, or the tasks with the ids in -Id; tasks have no name or -Filter. It needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Follow a check-now task

```powershell
$taskId = Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Uptime' | Invoke-ZbxCheckNow
Get-ZbxTask -Id $taskId | Select-Object TaskId, Type, Status, Clock
```

Invoke-ZbxCheckNow writes the id of the task it created.

### Example 2: List every task the server still tracks

```powershell
Get-ZbxTask | Select-Object TaskId, Type, Status
```

The server forgets a task some time after it is done.
